title: BAST/675/2002 of SMT. GHUNGHARA DEVI @ NIRMALA DEVI Vs STATE

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARANCHAL AT NAINITAL
Original Jurisdiction
Dated: Nainital: the 27th day of August 2002
Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 576 of 2002
Order on Bail Application
CRIMINAL SIDE
Rajender Prasad son of Sri Badri Prasad, resident of village Diyuri (Malli), Patti-Bamund,
District Tehri Garhwal
....................Applicant(s)
.........................Accused
Versus
State of Uttaranchal.
 ...................Opposite Party
Arising out of Case Crime No. 477 of 2002
Under Section 120B, 498A, 304B of I.P.C. & 3⁄4 of Dowry
Prohibition Act,
P.S. Chamba,
District Tehri Garhwal
By the Court
Hon'ble Irshad Hussain, J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and the learned A.G.A.
 Applicant-accused is the husband of the victim. In the dying declaration, she has not
attributed anything against the husband in regard to the demand of dowry etc.
Considering this fact, it is a fit case for bail.
Let the applicant Rajender Prasad son of Sri Badri Prasad resident of village Diyuri
(Malli), Patti-Bamund, District Tehri Garhwal be releaed on bail in case crime no. 477 of
2001, under sections 120B, 498A, 304B of I.P.C. & 3⁄4 of Dowry Prohibition Act,
P.S. Chamba, Dsitrict Tehri Garhwal on his filing a personal bond and adequate sureties
to the satisfaction of C.J.M., Tehri Garhwal.
 (Irshad Hussain, J.)
27.08.02/B
